description.zh:
使用第三方审批流程审批工单时，是否需要在DMS工单审批区域显示加签审批的按钮。取值如下：

- **true**（默认）：表示当DMS界面会显示加签按钮。

- **false**：表示DMS工单审批区域不会出现加签按钮。
description.en:
Specifies whether the Sign button is displayed in the ticket approval section of the DMS console for a third-party approval workflow. Valid values:

*   **true** (default): The Sign button is displayed.
*   **false**: The Sign button is not displayed.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

description.zh: 审批流ID，可通过调用接口[GetOrderBaseInfo](~~144642~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the approval workflow. You can call the [GetOrderBaseInfo](~~144642~~) operation to query the ID of the approval workflow.

title.zh: 为审批流设置额外信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise set-workflow-extra-info --tid 3000 --thirdparty-workflow-url https://xxx --thirdparty-workflow-comment test --workflow-instance-id 1840000 --render-agree true --render-reject false --render-add-approval-node false --render-transfer true --render-cancel true --region cn-hangzhou
